description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Nykthos Paragon.
When Nykthos Paragon enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Nykthos Paragon's toughness.
Nykthos Paragon triggers, causing you to put that many +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Repeat.
